opportunities.title: Large-item return requests
opportunities.problem: Mattress and furniture returns need a phone call. Refunds take up to two weeks.
opportunities.approach: Online return form creates a ticket, books pickup, and sends status texts through refund.

measure.baseline: Count large-item returns by channel from phone and ticket logs.
measure.target: Half of large returns started online

opportunities.days_30: Return paths and call reasons mapped
opportunities.days_60: Online return form live for mattresses
opportunities.assumption: Phone returns are a cost, not a deliberate step to save the sale.
opportunities.ask: How many large returns come by phone monthly, and how many does the agent save?

opportunities.title: Delivery and removal confirmations
opportunities.problem: Partners send separate links. Missed calls or texts push appointments back.
opportunities.approach: Pull partner scheduling status into Casper order messages, with reminders before each confirmation call.

measure.baseline: Pull RXO and LoadUp reschedules for last 90 days.

opportunities.days_30: Partner data feeds and reschedule causes known
opportunities.days_60: Reminder messages live for RXO deliveries

opportunities.ask: How many deliveries were rescheduled last quarter because a call or text was missed?

opportunities.title: Order status in chat
opportunities.problem: Tracking needs the shipping email. Night questions go to a bot.
opportunities.approach: Virtual assistant looks up orders by email and order number, then returns live tracking.

measure.baseline: Tag one week of chats, forms and calls by reason.
measure.target: Most tracking questions closed without an agent

opportunities.days_60: Bot order lookup live in chat
opportunities.days_90: Web form routes tracking questions to lookup
opportunities.assumption: The bot cannot already look up orders, and tracking questions are common.
opportunities.ask: What share of chats and calls are order status, and can the bot answer them?

Which mattress size is right for you?
When picking your next mattress, it’s more than just personal preference—two key things to keep in mind are how much room you have and who’s sleeping in the bed.
Upgrading to a King mattress is a game-changer if you’re sharing space with kids or pets. And if you’re tall, the extra length of a California King could be just right.
A Full size mattress is ideal for young adults or those with a smaller bedroom, while a Queen is the top pick for couples or anyone who enjoys extra space to sprawl out.
The Twin is the smallest option, ideal for single sleepers. While the Twin XL is a dorm favorite it can also create a Split King if you purchase two.
Which pillow size is right for you?
Pillow sizes can vary, but standard pillows, also known as queen pillows, are typically suitable for all types of sleepers. If you prefer extra space or need to fill the width of a larger mattress, king-size pillows, which are about 30% larger, are a great choice.

Due to changes in product availability, sometimes there will be “ships by” messaging on our site.
The product is set to ship by the date provided, at the latest, which means it can ship any day before.
While these orders have a slightly longer processing time, the travel time via UPS is still a standard 1-5 business days.
Shipping Fees
Shipping via UPS is free for mattresses, soft goods, and accessories within the contiguous United States.
We are unable to ship to APO and PO Boxes, or US Territories like Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
Let us do the heavy lifting for $249.
In Home Delivery and Setup Service + Optional Mattress Removal
How does In-Home Delivery and Setup Work?
When you purchase products to be delivered via our in-home delivery and set up partners at RXO, it typically takes 2-4 weeks for items to be delivered to your home. If your order includes soft goods like sheets and pillows, those items will be delivered directly to your door via UPS, while the mattress and furniture will be sent to our delivery partners. RXO will work with you to schedule a delivery date and removal if you opted into product removal at the time of purchase.
1.) After you have placed an order with In-Home Delivery and Setup, our partner RXO Logistics will send you an order confirmation (separate from your Casper order confirmation) with a scheduling link. Once your product(s) arrive at RXO's location, the scheduling link will update, and RXO's automated phone system will call and provide you with the next available date for delivery. You’ll also be able to talk to an RXO Scheduling agent.
2.) The day before your delivery date, you'll receive a call that confirms a four-hour delivery window in which your delivery team will arrive. During that four-hour window, they will call again within 30 minutes of their arrival. ​​You must answer both calls and confirm verbally to accept the delivery.
3.)The delivery team will bring your In-Home Delivery eligible Casper products to the appropriate room, set them up, and remove any packaging materials.
4.) You can also add a removal service to remove and recycle your previously owned mattress and foundation/box spring. To be eligible for the removal of a mattress and box spring, those items must be purchased through Casper. An order with one mattress will be eligible for the removal of one used mattress. An order with one foundation will be eligible for the removal of one used box spring/foundation.
All mattresses removed using Casper’s In-Home Delivery and Setup service must be in sanitary condition, to be determined by the on-site delivery team, and all box springs must be able to be removed without being broken down.
Please note that our delivery partner does not remove bed frames. In addition, our partners are limited to arranging and setting up Casper products only.
LoadUp: Mattress Removal Service
Casper partners with LoadUp, a national logistics and recycling company, to remove your old mattress and furniture. This optional service is available in eligible areas (excluding California) for $150 and can be selected at checkout.
) LoadUp will send you an email (separate from your Casper order confirmation) with a link to schedule your appointment.
) Scheduling is typically available as soon as the next day, up to 28 days in advance – appointments are scheduled in four-hour time slots.
) On the day of your appointment, you'll receive a text message or phone call when the LoadUp team is on the way. You must respond to this text or call to confirm. If you're unable to respond, your appointment may be rescheduled.
) Items are removed on a one-for-one basis, matching each eligible Casper product purchased. For example, if you purchased a Casper mattress and bedframe, LoadUp can only remove one mattress and one bed frame.
LoadUp provides removal services only and does not perform assembly or setup, so if you are interested in set-up services, check out In-Home Delivery & Setup option!
LoadUp can remove a maximum of three eligible items per appointment. If you need more than three items removed, consider our In-Home Delivery & Setup service.
LoadUp can remove mattresses, bed frames and adjustable bases, but cannot remove the Repose, or Haven bedframe or other non-eligible household items.
Frequently asked questions
Can you expedite shipping?
All Casper products ship via UPS Standard Shipping which typically takes 2-8 business days. Since we cannot expedite orders, your best bet would be to visit one of our stores. Click here to use our Store Locator to find the Casper Sleep Shop or partner store nearest you!
Do you deliver on Saturday or Sunday?
UPS will occasionally deliver ground packages on Saturdays. In order to get your order on Saturday or Sunday, we recommend having your packages delivered to a UPS store or friend's house ahead of the weekend, where you can pick up your packages at your own convenience.

pages.text:
Casper Return Center
Remember, it can take the body at least 30 days to adjust to a new mattress.
We give you 100 nights to try your mattress for free. Returns are free and easy anytime after the 30-Night Adjustment Period. See our expert tips for getting there faster.
Learn more
Pillows and Bedding Returns
You can return your Casper item and get a full refund within 30 days of delivery or within 30 days of an in-store purchase, provided the merchandise is unused, and in its original packaging and condition.
Print Shipping Labels
Contact us or click the order number in your original order confirmation email, to view and print your shipping label.
Prepare your package
Attach the return label to the outside of the box. If you don't have the original packaging, any sturdy box will do.
Ship it at no cost
Drop your return package off at any UPS location. Sit back and relax.
Furniture Returns
It’s important to test out all your Casper products in your own sleep environment. We offer a 30-night trial on our furniture products so that you can do just that. When you purchase your furniture with a paired mattress, we're happy to extend the trial to 100 nights to match that of your mattress. As long as your furniture is in donate-able condition, you can return it without the original packaging or box, even if it has been assembled.
Glow, Mattress Topper, and Dog Bed Returns
Our Glows, Mattress Toppers, and Dog Bed all come with 30-night trials. If this product isn't right for you or your pup, email our Customer Experience team here for assistance.
Bundle Returns
When you purchase a Casper Bundle, all of the items in the bundle will have the same trial period. If your bundle includes a mattress, the entire bundle will have a 100-night trial period.
Refunds
Refunds will be credited back to your account within two weeks.
If you paid for shipping to Hawaii or Alaska, you’ll get a refund for those shipping costs as well.
If you paid for our in-home delivery and setup service, we will not refund for the service performed.
You may return a maximum of two items of the same product type.
For more information on our return policy, see Terms .
